title: Grenade

cues.en: Easy come, easy go, that's just how you live, all take, take, take it all, but you never give.
cues.zh: 來得容易，去得也快，這就是你的生活方式，索取，索取，索取，但你從不給予。
cues.text: Easy come, easy go, that's just how you live, all take, take, take it all, but you never give.

cues.en: Shouldn't know, you was trouble from the first kiss, had your eyes wide open, why would they open?
cues.zh: 不該知道，你初吻就麻煩了，眼睛睜得大大的，怎麼會睜開？
cues.text: Shouldn't know, you was trouble from the first kiss, had your eyes wide open, why would they open?

cues.en: Gave you all a head and you tossed it in the trash, you tossed it in the trash you did.
cues.zh: 給了你們所有人一個頭，然後你們把它扔進了垃圾桶，你把它扔進了垃圾桶。
cues.text: Gave you all a head and you tossed it in the trash, you tossed it in the trash you did.

cues.en: So give me all your love is all I ever asked cause, what you don't understand is I catch a grenade for ya.
cues.zh: 所以，給我你所有的愛是我所要求的一切，因為你不明白的是我為你接住了一顆手榴彈。
cues.text: So give me all your love is all I ever asked cause, what you don't understand is I catch a grenade for ya.

cues.en: Throw my hand on a blade for ya, I jump in front of a tree for ya.
cues.zh: 為你把手放在刀上，為你跳到樹前。
cues.text: Throw my hand on a blade for ya, I jump in front of a tree for ya.

cues.en: You know I do anything for ya, oh, oh, I would go through all this pain, take a bullet straight through my brain.
cues.zh: 你知道我會為你做任何事，哦，哦，我會經歷所有這些痛苦，一顆子彈直接穿過我的大腦。
cues.text: You know I do anything for ya, oh, oh, I would go through all this pain, take a bullet straight through my brain.

cues.en: Yes, I'll wait time for ya, baby, but you won't do the same thing.
cues.zh: 是的，我會等你的時間，寶貝，但你不會做同樣的事情。
cues.text: Yes, I'll wait time for ya, baby, but you won't do the same thing.

cues.en: No, no, no, no, no, black, black, black and blue, beat me till I'm numb, tell me tell more, I say hey when you get back to where you're from.
cues.zh: 不，不，不，不，不，黑，黑，黑，藍，打我直到我麻木，告訴我告訴更多，我說嘿，當你回到你原來的地方。
cues.text: No, no, no, no, no, black, black, black and blue, beat me till I'm numb, tell me tell more, I say hey when you get back to where you're from.

cues.en: Red woman, red woman, that's just what you are, yeah you're smiling, my face the ripple breaks out my car.
cues.zh: 紅色女人，紅色女人，這就是你，是的，你在微笑，我的臉泛起漣漪，衝破了我的車。
cues.text: Red woman, red woman, that's just what you are, yeah you're smiling, my face the ripple breaks out my car.
